# Montana Contracting
Montana Contracting is a general contractor based in Congers, NY, serving the Hudson Valley, New York, and New Jersey since 1984. The firm specializes in high-end residential and commercial construction, pre-construction services, and construction financing through a partnership with Procida Funding.

## Pre-Construction
Detailed four-phase pre-construction process with interactive timeline and proprietary NOVATERRA cost intelligence. Budget accuracy within single-digit percentages of final cost.
- Page: https://montanacontracting.com/pre-construction

## Services
- Pre-construction budgeting with proprietary NOVATERRA cost intelligence
- General contracting for residential and commercial projects
- Construction financing for multi-family, affordable housing, and large-scale commercial projects (via Procida Funding)
